title: Canonical integral and field-stage left compositor data
statement: Fix the setting [sk-def-sf-setting], operations [sk-def-sf-operations], and normalized constructible adjunction systems [lem-sf-constructible-exceptional-adjunction-coefficients]. Reuse the finite compact-support compositor and its exceptional conjugate [def-sf-finite-exceptional-compositor-maps]. For composable separated finite-type maps f:X→Y and g:Y→Z and systems P,Q,R, define integralInclusion as the finite-Tor integral full-subcategory inclusion. Define integralLeft as the normalized comparison of P with the specified integral compact-support functor. Define integralAlpha by pasting integralLeft for g and f, the inverse specified compact-support compositor [thm-sf-comp-composition], and inverse integralLeft for gf, lifted through the fully faithful inclusion. Define LeftCoefficientEquation as equality on every object of the two paths made from a left compositor and three specified left scalar comparisons. Given six-operation data S at each finite field and positive exponent, LeftCompositors consists of alpha at every coefficient stage and compactification triple, with finite alpha equal to finiteAlpha, integral alpha equal to integralAlpha, and LeftCoefficientEquation for the prescribed rationalization and common-finite-stage maps. This is a data type and does not assert its existence.
